text: Sunday schedule: NFL starts with Patriots-Lions at 9:30 AM ET on Fox. Afternoon NFL includes Chiefs-Falcons on CBS plus Texans-Browns, Vikings-Packers, Jaguars-Titans, and Dolphins-Colts. NBA has Pacers-76ers at 1 PM ET on DAZN IND. College hoops runs all day with ESPN, ABC, FS1, BTN, SECN+, and B1G+. Golf is all-day too on ESPN+, CNBC, and Golf Channel. Follow @any_and_all_sports for the daily schedule.
